clause: Typed read/write object model over StudioDocument (scripting DOM) [STU-AUT-006]

scope.summary: Expose the canonical primitive set as a typed read/write object model over the single StudioDocument (the scripting-DOM equivalent) WITHOUT a parallel object hierarchy and WITHOUT a second in-memory document model. Reads project canonical primitive fields; writes are expressed as Section-1 commands inheriting dry-run/receipt/undo/promotion. The object model IS a typed view over the one StudioDocument the engines and Postgres JSONB authority share.
acceptance_criteria: one typed object-model view over StudioDocument; no parallel hierarchy or second doc model
proof_targets: typed-view read/write over single document test
expected_tests: test: object model reads project canonical fields (no forked types)
live: object-model write dispatches a command with receipt+undo
negative: no second in-memory document model instantiated

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Automation / The Studio object model (model layer)

risk_if_missed: A parallel scripting DOM forks types / a second document model drifts from authority.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
